findings.body: The new attachment interface has no executable coverage. The stub in tests/test_chatview_start.py accepts thread/attachment/add, but every test invokes work or read; no test calls codex.attach or exercises this driver branch. Removing the attachment implementation would leave the suite green. Add integration coverage using the real driver and SDK with the app-server stub, verifying the recorded thread, identity, payload, no request without a recorded conversation, and non-fatal request errors. This tests START's interface without requiring ATTACH's future forge close integration.
findings.title: Not done: attachment request tests
